title: Rollout Scheduling for Chaotic Neural ODEs: Coverage Gains, Computational Cost, and Predictive Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2611.28192v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs) on chaotic systems is difficult because small changes in model parameters can lead to rapidly growing differences in predictions. A rollout is a trajectory predicted by the model. Choosing its length from a single global Lyapunov time overlooks differences in local instability. We study rollout scheduling for training on one contiguous rollout per sampled state, asking whether adapting its length to local instability improves prediction. We find the schedule that uses the most trajectory data under an instability budget, a limit on how much instability any one rollout may accumulate. Under stated assumptions, we bound the resulting coverage gain and the coverage lost when the instability estimates are in error. Numerical checks illustrate the theory. translated_title: 混沌神经常微分方程的Rollout调度：覆盖增益、计算成本与预测精度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28192v1 公告类型：交叉。在混沌系统上训练神经常微分方程存在困难，因为模型参数的微小变化会导致预测差异迅速增长。Rollout（推演轨迹）是指模型所预测出的轨迹，若仅依据单一的全局Lyapunov时间来选择其长度，就会忽略局部不稳定性的差异。本文研究训练中的rollout调度问题，即对每个采样状态使用一段连续的rollout进行训练，探讨根据局部不稳定性自适应调整其长度能否改进预测。作者找出了在不稳定性预算（即对任何单个rollout可累积不稳定性总量的限制）约束下能使用最多轨迹数据的调度方案，并在给定假设下，对该方案带来的覆盖增益以及不稳定性估计存在误差时所损失的覆盖给出了理论界定。数值验证阐明了该理论。在Lorenz-63、Lorenz-96和Kuramoto--Sivashinsky系统上的训练实验在相同计算成本下比较了自适应调度与固定调度（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向混沌系统神经ODE训练的rollout长度自适应调度方法，在不稳定性预算约束下最大化轨迹数据覆盖并给出覆盖增益的理论界，实验表明其在相同计算成本下优于固定调度并提升预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes adaptive rollout scheduling for training Neural ODEs on chaotic systems, finding the schedule that maximizes trajectory coverage under an instability budget with theoretical bounds, and showing improved predictive accuracy over constant schedules at equal computational cost.
